avatar-1.prompt: MenteFu's official mascot, always drawn exactly the same. MODEL SHEET, do not redesign: one single kawaii shonen-anime character, alone, never two. Its head IS a big soft pale pink brain with gently rounded folds and a visible central groove, wider than tall, taking about half of the total height. The brain is PALE PINK (soft rosy pink, never orange, never peach, always clearly lighter and pinker than the orange gi) — no hair, no ears, no human skull shape, no nose, genderless with no gender cues. A white headband with a small knot and short tails on the right side crosses the lower part of the brain. Below it, a small chibi body with short arms and legs and small bare feet, wearing a martial-arts gi in orange-vermilion with a dark brown belt and a white headband tied at the side. Both eyes are always large, round and identical to each other in size and shape. Same proportions, same pale pink brain colour, same orange-vermilion gi and same brown belt in every image: ONLY the pose and the facial expression change. Portrait bust only, head and shoulders, centered, front view. calm friendly smile, eyes open
